title: Texas' 32nd Congressional District general election, 2026
description: The general election for Texas' 32nd Congressional District pits Republican nominee Jace Yarbrough against Democratic nominee Dan Barrios. The district was redrawn in August 2025, shifting from a Democratic-leaning Dallas-based seat (D+22) to a Republican-leaning seat (R+17) stretching from Dallas suburbs into East Texas. Incumbent Rep. Julie Johnson (D) ran for re-election in the neighboring 33rd District, leaving this an open seat. The race is considered a top Republican pickup opportunity, with President Donald Trump and other major conservative figures endorsing Yarbrough.

candidates.name: Dan Barrios
candidates.summary: Dan Barrios is a Richardson City Councilmember (Place 3, elected May 2023) and the Democratic nominee for Texas' 32nd Congressional District, having won the March 3 Democratic primary. He is a former educator, nonprofit sales director, and American Red Cross volunteer with an MBA from the University of North Texas. Barrios emphasizes lowering costs, improving healthcare access, and restoring trust in government through practical, community-focused leadership.
